name: BURN round 6 — theory tests + constraint verifier + shadowbonk repair drafts

lanes.prompt: You are a corpus engineer (Grok build-order item 3, accepted by Mag Estate). Read watch/corpus/L0_CANONICAL.md (the sealed L0 contract) and watch/corpus/L1_engines/constraint_puzzle.DRAFT.md. Write the CONSTRAINT VERIFIER INTERFACE per the accepted signature: V1 LEGAL-PARTIAL, V2 COMPLETE?, V3 UNIQUE? (external solver — the lane calls a solver-shaped stub and labels it), V4 DIFFICULTY, V5 INVENTORY, plus the Sudoku pack binding (9x9, 1..9, all-different row/col/box, 81-char instance, V3 mandatory, 16 givens illegal to emit as unique). Output the complete file content for corpus/L1_engines/constraint_verifier_interface.DRAFT.md, mechanical, no scholarship.

You are a corpus pack writer. Read watch/corpus/L0_CANONICAL.md and watch/corpus/game_riddles/riddle_sudoku_uniqueness_constraint.json + riddle_sudoku_candidate_timeout.json (real verifier riddles from our own play). Write corpus L2 pack: sudoku.DRAFT.md per the house format (PROMPT-BODY-START, flags, slots) binding the constraint verifier interface. The pack MUST state: instances with fewer than 17 givens are emitted with uniqueness=unverified, never unique. Under 3000 chars of mechanics.

You are an auditor. Read memory/runs/orchestrator/tasks/ sample (60 recent task records) + training/cost_ledger.jsonl tail. The FLEET MIX LAW claims >=94% of spend on cheap lanes, <=6% frontier. Count actual model usage by provider across the sampled records, compute the real ratio, and verdict: LAW HOLDS or LAW BROKEN with numbers. Cite the records you counted.

You are a verifier. The estate's top still-live fault: mag/backend server run_task never copies result.error into the envelope, so agent_cli falls back to 'backend reported failure'. Read mag/backend (or server.py) run_task region + mag/agent_cli.py fallback site. Confirm or refute: (1) the error-drop exists at the named site, (2) the fallback string is what FKB hashes, (3) the loop-close patch in agent_cli does not depend on this fault. Cite exact lines.

You are a repair verifier. dashboard/static/shadowbonk.html has a 6-fault list: (1) pick3() double const declaration, (2) unclosed keydown brace at ~line 84, (3) undefined $, (4) undefined gid, (5) undefined hidePause, (6) spawnBoss pushes into EN not ENS. Read the file. For each fault: CONFIRM (line evidence) or REFUTE. Then return the minimal fix as unified-diff-style before/after lines. Do not apply — draft only.

You are a game historian + mechanic designer. Read watch/corpus/ONE_WAY_MIRROR_RSVP_20260922.md (the 1958 RSVP vertical crossword mapped to one-way-mirror doctrine) and watch/corpus/L1_engines/race_dice.DRAFT.md. Design the RSVP TABLE as a seventh-family candidate OR an L3 pack over an existing engine: which six-function bindings fit a double-sided shared grid? What are the pack deltas for the 1966 Scrabble RSVP reskin? Output the pack skeleton. Under 2500 chars of mechanics.
